other_conditions: Beneficiary must be a girl aged 18 years or older.
Beneficiary must be a resident of Haryana.

Beneficiary must belong to one of the following groups: daughter of a widow/divorced/destitute woman, orphan girl, member of SC/DT/Tapriwas communities, daughter of a sportswoman (any caste), any general or backward class family, or a person with disabilities (Divyangjan).
benefits_summary: Cash assistance of up to ₹71,000 as Shagun, with amounts varying by category, plus an additional ₹1,100 Shagun and a sweet box for families not covered under the main provisions.
